answer: To resist Sybil attacks, an agent economy can enforce proof-of-burn registration, requiring each new identity to permanently destroy native tokens before transacting. This makes the cost of spawning fake nodes crystal clear, as an attacker must forfeit real capital into an unrecoverable cryptographic ember for every fabricated persona. By imposing this steep financial ledge, the protocol ensures that flooding the network with fraudulent agents becomes economically ruinous.
